title: Shop sheet with prices
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y2 lesson 6 (Shop sheet with prices (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 6: Keeping money safe; can I afford it?. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: Keeping money safe
points: Banks keep money safe for grown-ups

model.title: I have 10p, 5p and 2p. The pencil costs 15p. Can I afford it?

head: Item
Price
Can I afford it with 20p? (yes or no)

blocks.text: Colour the things you can afford with 20p.

blocks.answers: Yes (20p or less): bookmark 5p, sticker 8p, pencil 12p, rubber 15p, apple 20p. No: notebook 25p, ball 30p, toy car 45p.

keywords.def: have enough money to buy it

questions.q: Show me: I have 5p and 5p. A sticker costs 8p. Can I afford it?
Show me: one safe place for money at home.
questions.a: A money box (kept by a grown-up).

questions.q: Core: Shop sheet: colour the things you can afford with 20p (pupil PDF).
Extend: Choose one want and plan how many weeks to save 5p a week to buy it.
questions.a: For example: a 20p ruler takes 4 weeks.

questions.q: You have 8p. A rubber costs 10p. What do you do?
questions.a: B) Save and wait. 8p is less than 10p, so save until you have enough.

questions.q: To afford something we need... A) enough money B) any money C) a friend's money
Big question: where is the safest place for pocket money?
questions.a: A money box kept safe at home.
